经过: 孟观破氐羌，擒齐万年。
text_en: Meng Guan crushes the Di and Qiang rising and captures Qi Wannian.

经过: 李特攻成都，赵廞败死。
text_en: Li Te attacks Chengdu, and Zhao Xin is defeated and killed.

经过: 陈敏、周玘破石冰，石冰败死。
text_en: Chen Min and Zhou Qi defeat Shi Bing, who is killed.

经过: 顾荣、甘卓等倒戈，陈敏败死。
text_en: Gu Rong, Gan Zhuo and others turn against Chen Min, who is defeated and killed.

经过: 王如降王敦。
text_en: Wang Ru surrenders to Wang Dun.

经过: 陶侃平杜弢，杜弢败亡。
text_en: Tao Kan puts down Du Tao, who perishes in defeat.

经过: 石勒擒刘曜（328），次年灭前赵。
text_en: Shi Le captures Liu Yao (328) and destroys the Former Zhao the next year.

经过: 后赵与前燕共攻段辽，段部亡。
text_en: The Later Zhao and the Former Yan attack Duan Liao together, and the Duan fall.

经过: 慕容皝灭宇文部。
text_en: Murong Huang destroys the Yuwen.

经过: 桓温入成都，李势降，成汉亡。
text_en: Huan Wen enters Chengdu and Li Shi surrenders; Cheng Han falls.

经过: 石祗为部将所杀，后赵亡。
text_en: Shi Zhi is killed by his own general, and the Later Zhao falls.

经过: 前燕擒冉闵于廉台，克邺，冉魏亡。
text_en: The Former Yan captures Ran Min at Liantai and takes Ye; Ran Wei falls.

经过: 慕容恪围广固，段龛降。
text_en: Murong Ke besieges Guanggu and Duan Kan surrenders.

经过: 前秦苻坚攻并州，张平降。
text_en: Fu Jian of the Former Qin attacks Bing Province, and Zhang Ping surrenders.

经过: 王猛破邺，擒慕容暐，前燕亡。
text_en: Wang Meng takes Ye and captures Murong Wei; the Former Yan falls.

经过: 前秦攻仇池，杨纂降（385 年杨定复国）。
text_en: The Former Qin attacks Chouchi and Yang Zuan surrenders (Yang Ding restores the state in 385).

经过: 前秦攻姑臧，张天锡降，前凉亡。
text_en: The Former Qin attacks Guzang and Zhang Tianxi surrenders; the Former Liang falls.

经过: 前秦伐代，什翼犍死，代亡（386 年拓跋珪复国为魏）。
text_en: The Former Qin attacks Dai; Shiyijian dies and Dai falls (Tuoba Gui restores it as Wei in 386).

经过: 域外：匈人破东哥特，西哥特渡多瑙河入罗马。
text_en: The Huns crush the Ostrogoths, and the Visigoths cross the Danube into the Roman Empire.

经过: 北魏与后燕合击刘显，独孤部破。
text_en: The Northern Wei and the Later Yan strike Liu Xian together, and the Dugu are broken.

经过: 后燕慕容垂破滑台，翟钊奔西燕，翟魏亡。
text_en: Murong Chui of the Later Yan takes Huatai, and Zhai Zhao flees to the Western Yan; Zhai Wei falls.

经过: 苻登为后秦所杀，太子苻崇旋败死，前秦亡。
text_en: Fu Deng is killed by the Later Qin and his heir Fu Chong soon dies in defeat; the Former Qin falls.

经过: 后燕克长子，杀慕容永，西燕亡。
text_en: The Later Yan takes Zhangzi and kills Murong Yong; the Western Yan falls.

经过: 乞伏乾归降后秦（409 年复国）。
title_en: The Western Qin submits to the Later Qin
text_en: Qifu Gangui surrenders to the Later Qin (he restores his state in 409).

经过: 桓玄篡晋，建国号楚（次年刘裕起兵复晋）。
title_en: Huan Xuan usurps the Jin throne
text_en: Huan Xuan takes the Jin throne and names his dynasty Chu (Liu Yu rises the next year and restores Jin).

经过: 吕隆降后秦，后凉亡。
text_en: Lü Long surrenders to the Later Qin; the Later Liang falls.

经过: 桓玄败死（404），桓振收余众，405 年败亡。
text_en: Huan Xuan dies in defeat (404); Huan Zhen gathers the survivors and is finally crushed in 405.

经过: 冯跋等杀慕容熙，立高云，后燕亡。
text_en: Feng Ba and others kill Murong Xi and enthrone Gao Yun; the Later Yan falls.

经过: 刘裕克广固，擒慕容超，南燕亡。
text_en: Liu Yu takes Guanggu and captures Murong Chao; the Southern Yan falls.

经过: 朱龄石克成都，谯纵自杀。
text_en: Zhu Lingshi takes Chengdu and Qiao Zong kills himself.

经过: 西秦袭乐都，秃发傉檀降，南凉亡。
text_en: The Western Qin surprises Ledu and Tufa Rutan surrenders; the Southern Liang falls.

经过: 刘裕入长安，姚泓降，后秦亡。
text_en: Liu Yu enters Chang'an and Yao Hong surrenders; the Later Qin falls.

经过: 刘裕受禅，东晋亡。
text_en: Liu Yu receives the abdication, and the Eastern Jin falls.

经过: 北凉沮渠蒙逊克敦煌，西凉亡。
text_en: Juqu Mengxun of the Northern Liang takes Dunhuang; the Western Liang falls.

经过: 域外：萨珊废亚美尼亚国王，改设总督。
text_en: The Sasanians depose the king of Armenia and rule it through a governor.

经过: 夏赫连定杀乞伏暮末，西秦亡。
text_en: Helian Ding of Xia kills Qifu Mumo; the Western Qin falls.

经过: 吐谷浑擒赫连定，夏亡。
text_en: The Tuyuhun capture Helian Ding; Xia falls.

经过: 北魏攻和龙，冯弘奔高句丽，北燕亡。
text_en: The Northern Wei attacks Helong and Feng Hong flees to Goguryeo; the Northern Yan falls.

经过: 宋将裴方明破仇池，杨难当奔北魏（其后杨氏复立）。
text_en: The Song general Pei Fangming takes Chouchi and Yang Nandang flees to the Northern Wei (the Yang family later restore their rule).

经过: 北魏万度归破鄯善；448 年以韩拔为鄯善王，比于郡县。
text_en: Wan Duogui of the Northern Wei defeats Shanshan; in 448 Han Ba is made king of Shanshan and it is ruled like a commandery.

经过: 沮渠安周破车师前部，车伊洛奔焉耆。
text_en: Juqu Anzhou crushes Nearer Jushi, and its king Ju Yiluo flees to Karasahr.

经过: 柔然攻高昌，杀沮渠安周，立阚伯周为高昌王，北凉亡。
text_en: The Rouran attack Gaochang, kill Juqu Anzhou and make Kan Bozhou king of Gaochang; the Northern Liang falls.

经过: 域外：阿提拉诸子败亡，匈人帝国瓦解。
text_en: Attila's sons are defeated one after another, and the Hunnic Empire falls apart.

经过: 萧道成受禅，刘宋亡。
text_en: Xiao Daocheng receives the abdication, and the Liu Song falls.

经过: 夫余为勿吉所逐，夫余王举国降高句丽。
text_en: Driven out by the Wuji, the king of Buyeo submits to Goguryeo with his whole realm.

经过: 萧衍受禅，南齐亡。
text_en: Xiao Yan receives the abdication, and the Southern Qi falls.

经过: 北魏借柔然兵破破六韩拔陵，降户二十万。
text_en: With Rouran troops the Northern Wei crushes Poliuhan Baling, and two hundred thousand of his followers surrender.

经过: 域外：阿克苏姆渡海灭希木叶尔。
text_en: Aksum crosses the Red Sea and destroys Himyar.

经过: 莫折念生为部将杜粲所杀。
text_en: Mozhe Niansheng is killed by his officer Du Can.

经过: 葛荣杀杜洛周，并其众。
text_en: Ge Rong kills Du Luozhou and takes over his followers.

经过: 尔朱荣破葛荣于滏口，擒之。
text_en: Erzhu Rong defeats Ge Rong at Fukou and captures him.

经过: 元天穆讨擒邢杲。
text_en: Yuan Tianmu crushes and captures Xing Gao.

经过: 尔朱天光、贺拔岳破擒万俟丑奴。
text_en: Erzhu Tianguang and Heba Yue defeat and capture Moqi Chounu.

经过: 高欢袭秀容，尔朱兆自缢。
text_en: Gao Huan surprises Xiurong and Erzhu Zhao hangs himself.

经过: 孝武帝西奔宇文泰，高欢另立孝静帝，北魏分为东、西魏。
text_en: Emperor Xiaowu flees west to Yuwen Tai and Gao Huan enthrones Emperor Xiaojing; the Northern Wei splits into the Eastern and Western Wei.

经过: 柔然破高车，高车亡。
text_en: The Rouran crush Gaoche, and Gaoche falls.

经过: 高洋受禅，东魏亡。
text_en: Gao Yang receives the abdication, and the Eastern Wei falls.

经过: 王僧辩、陈霸先克建康，侯景败死。
text_en: Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian take Jiankang, and Hou Jing is killed in flight.

经过: 突厥土门破柔然，阿那瓌自杀（555 年余部亡）。
text_en: Tumen of the Turks crushes the Rouran and Anagui kills himself (the last Rouran are destroyed in 555).

经过: 陈霸先受禅，梁亡（江陵后梁仍存）。
text_en: Chen Baxian receives the abdication, and Liang falls (the Later Liang at Jiangling survives).

经过: 宇文觉受禅，西魏亡。
text_en: Yuwen Jue receives the abdication, and the Western Wei falls.

经过: 王琳为陈所败，奔北齐。
text_en: Wang Lin is defeated by Chen and flees to the Northern Qi.

经过: 新罗灭大伽倻。
text_en: Silla destroys Daegaya.

经过: 北周克邺，擒高纬，北齐亡。
text_en: The Northern Zhou takes Ye and captures Gao Wei; the Northern Qi falls.

经过: 杨坚受禅，北周亡。
text_en: Yang Jian receives the abdication, and the Northern Zhou falls.
